2→4 charges (3 s each): slide 4→8 blocks the way you move (else where you look), untouchable for a moment; monsters within 6→10 of the start lose track of you. Speed II for 2 s. From tier 3 your afterimage bursts for 0.6× damage.
Source: Soul Land · 鬼影迷踪 Ghost Shadow Perplexing Track, the Tang Sect speed art: in a fight the user seems to glide over the ground
In a fight the user seems to glide over the ground, leaving only a grey shadow behind.
kultivator.technique.mysterious_jade_han: For 1.5→2.5 s your jade hands catch 2→5 hostile projectiles in front (120°, 3 blocks) and answer the shooter with a 1× strike; damage from the front −50%; melee attackers in front take 1.2×. Cleanses poison, wither, slowness and other ailments.
Source: Soul Land · 玄玉手 Mysterious Jade Hand, the Tang Sect palm art: jade-hard hands that block poison and catch hidden weapons
Jade-hard hands that neither poison nor hidden weapons can pass.
kultivator.technique.purple_demon_eye.de: A violet gaze pierces up to 3 monsters along 16→28 blocks: 1.2× armour-piercing damage, Slowness II and Weakness I for 2 s. ×1.5 at dawn under open sky.
kultivator.technique.purple_demon_eye.so: Source: Soul Land · 紫极魔瞳 Purple Demon Eyes, the Tang Sect eye art trained facing the rising sun; at depth it releases a strong spiritual attack
kultivator.technique.purple_demon_eye.lo: Trained facing the rising sun, the eyes see deeper with every dawn.
kultivator.technique.pear_blossom_needle: 9→27 needles in a 25° fan, 16→32 blocks: 0.3× armour-piercing damage each, at most 4 per monster.
Source: Soul Land · 暴雨梨花针 Violent Rain Pear Blossom Needles, the Tang Sect hidden weapon that fires twenty-seven needles in a row
Twenty-seven needles in a single breath, like pear blossoms in a storm.
kultivator.technique.sleep_insects.desc: Drowsy bugs drift through an 8→16-block cone: monsters fall asleep for 3→5 s (bosses are rooted for 1 s), Blindness 2 s, and your next hit on them deals ×2.
kultivator.technique.sleep_insects.sourc: Source: Journey to the West ch. 5, 25, 71 · 瞌睡蟲 sleep-inducing bugs, which Wukong flicks onto guards and demons
kultivator.technique.sleep_insects.lore: A flick of the fingers, and the guards are snoring.
kultivator.technique.immobilization_spel: Your locked target (≤ 24 blocks) takes 1.5× and is fixed in place, stunned for 3→5 s (bosses rooted 0.75 s); from the next tier on, one more monster per tier within 4 of it (at most 4) is fixed too.
Source: Journey to the West ch. 5, 97 · 定身法 the immobilization magic; in ch. 5 Wukong fixes the Seven Fairies in the Peach Garden
kultivator.technique.emperor_seal_jue.de: Up to 4 seals, each recast within 4 s: 1 the Open Mountain Seal falls on the aim (r 3→6): 1.5× and stun 1.5 s; 2 (Nascent Soul) a shock wave out to r 8→16: 1.2× and knockback; 3 (Deity Transformation) pillars throw 6→10 monsters up and slam them down for 1.5×; 4 (Dao Union) the emperor seal (r 8→14): 2.5× and stun 2 s.
kultivator.technique.emperor_seal_jue.so: Source: Battle Through the Heavens · 帝印决 Emperor Seal Jue, the seal art Xun'er leaves Xiao Yan; its first seal is 开山印 Open Mountain Seal (donghua ep. 48). Stages 2–4 are game design and carry no canon names
kultivator.technique.emperor_seal_jue.lo: The seal art Xun'er left behind, still warm with her care.
kultivator.technique.fiery_golden_eyes.d: Scans 24→32 blocks: up to 32 monsters lose Invisibility, are marked for you through walls and take +20% (+5% per tier, at most +40%) from you for 20 s. Night Vision 20 s. With Divine Sense active the scan reaches ×1.25 further (within the cap).
kultivator.technique.fiery_golden_eyes.s: Source: Journey to the West ch. 7 · 火眼金睛: forty-nine days in Laozi's Eight Trigrams Furnace give Wukong fiery eyes and golden pupils that see through every disguise (the furnace itself is the Fire art Eight Trigrams Furnace)
kultivator.technique.fiery_golden_eyes.l: No disguise survives eyes forged in the furnace.
kultivator.technique.finger_of_death.des: A grey-black finger of qi strikes your locked target (24→32 blocks): 2.2× armour-piercing damage, executing it below 30% health (bosses below 5%). A kill restores 8% qi.
kultivator.technique.finger_of_death.sou: Source: Renegade Immortal ch. 543, 734 · Finger of Death, the demonic killing spell devised by Situ Nan and used by Wang Lin
kultivator.technique.finger_of_death.lor: A demonic killing spell: one finger, one life.
kultivator.technique.body_beyond_body.de: Blow out 3→8 hair clones; each clings to a monster within 12 for 10→15 s and strikes it every second for 0.25×.
kultivator.technique.body_beyond_body.so: Source: Journey to the West ch. 2 · 身外身法 Body Beyond Body: Wukong plucks hairs, chews them and shouts "Change!", and they become little monkeys that swarm the Demon of Havoc
kultivator.technique.body_beyond_body.lo: Pluck, chew, shout "Change!" — and a troop of little monkeys appears.
kultivator.technique.netherworld_white_t: Cast together with a bonded disciple of another Dao (bond ≥ 50, within 16 blocks): both glow for 1 s, then a white tiger charges 24→48 blocks: (2 + 2 × the disciple's power ÷ yours)× damage, knockback and the disciple Dao's domain pulse. ×1.5 with your heir. The disciple pays half the cost and shares the cooldown.
Source: Soul Land · 幽冥白虎 Netherworld White Tiger, the martial soul fusion skill of Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing
Only a player can cast this together with a disciple.
Needs a bonded disciple (bond ≥ 50) of another Dao within 16 blocks.
Your disciple lacks the qi for the fusion.
kultivator.technique.somersault_cloud.de: Ride a golden cloud 64→128 blocks the way you look in 2 s, 3 blocks above the ground and untouchable while riding; it stops at walls and unloaded land and sets you down on a safe spot (refused when there is none). No fall damage for 5 s.
kultivator.technique.somersault_cloud.so: Source: Journey to the West ch. 2 · 觔斗雲 cloud somersault: Subhuti teaches it, 108,000 li in a single somersault
kultivator.technique.somersault_cloud.lo: 108,000 li in a single somersault — here, a little less.
kultivator.technique.somersault_cloud.wh: Only a player can ride the cloud.
kultivator.technique.qilin_sacred_palace: Raise a golden palace of r 4→8 at your feet for 6→10 s: monsters are kept outside its walls and take 0.5× and knockback at the wall each second; you and your allies inside take 60% less damage, and hostile projectiles crossing the wall vanish.
Source: Against the Gods ch. 2008 · Qilin Sacred Palace, the Qilin God's defence, named with the Black Tortoise's Xuanji Tower as one of the two greatest defences
Named beside the Black Tortoise's Xuanji Tower among the two greatest defences.
kultivator.technique.seventy_two_transfo: Take a form for 60→90 s (3 qi/s, −0.3 per tier, at least 1); recast within 5 s to cycle: Tiger (larger, Speed II, Strength I, melee +0.6×), Hawk (small, slow falling; recast in the air looking down to dive for 2.5×), Fish (water breathing, Speed II), Insect (tiny; nearby monsters lose track of you), Temple (rooted, Resistance III, Regeneration II, attackers take 0.4×). 50 qi per change; 10 s cooldown after the form ends.
Source: Journey to the West ch. 2, 6 · 地煞七十二变 the seventy-two earthly transformations Subhuti teaches; in ch. 6 Wukong uses them against Erlang Shen, last as a temple
Last of all, Wukong stood before Erlang Shen as a temple.
Only a player can take these forms.
Your body is still settling after the last form (%s s).
Out of qi — the transformation fades.
kultivator.technique.three_heads_six_arm: War form for 20→30 s: every melee hit adds two phantom-arm strikes of 0.6× on the target and the nearest other monster within 4; attack speed +50%, damage from behind −50%, cooldowns run ×1.25 faster.
Source: Journey to the West ch. 4 · 三头六臂 Wukong's three-headed, six-armed war form; Desolate Era · Ji Ning manifests three heads and six arms
Three heads to watch, six arms to strike.
kultivator.technique.blood_death_world.d: Forbidden: costs 20% of your max health (never lethal). A blood domain of r 10→18 follows you for 8→12 s: monsters bleed 0.35× per second, are blinded and slowed, and you drain 30% of it; every second Blood Finger strikes the weakest for 1.2× and executes it below 10%.
kultivator.technique.blood_death_world.s: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 203, 447 · Meng Hao's killing moves Blood Finger and Blood Death World; in ch. 447 it is a blinding blood field
kultivator.technique.blood_death_world.l: The sky turns crimson, and nothing inside can see.
kultivator.technique.bloodshadow_evasion: Forbidden: costs 30% of your max health (never lethal) and can be cast with no qi. Monsters within 16 lose track of you and you flash 32→64 blocks back to the safest loaded spot (no monster within 8): damage −80% for 3 s, no fall damage for 5 s, then Weakness I for 30 s.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 血影遁 Bloodshadow Evasion: Han Li ignites his blood essence to flee in an instant (no distance claimed)
Ignite the blood essence, and be gone before the blade falls.
kultivator.technique.moon_star_restorati: Forbidden: costs 15% of your current health (never lethal). For 2→3 s incoming damage is cancelled and stored (up to 2× your max health; never tribulations or the void); at 50% of your max health stored, or at the end, it bursts in r 6→14: 2× plus twice the stored damage, and knockback.
Source: Against the Gods · 月挽星回 Moon Star Restoration, a skill of the Heretic God Art's 4th realm "Rumbling Heaven": it instantly rebounds any attack at a heavy lifespan cost
The moon is drawn back and the stars return — and the years pay for it.
kultivator.technique.ji_realm.desc: A colourless cone of 16→24 blocks tears at souls: 2.4× armour-piercing damage, executes below 30% health (bosses below 5%), executes any non-boss whose max health is under 2× your power, Slowness IV 3 s. Your soul pays: no qi regeneration for 15 s.
kultivator.technique.ji_realm.source: Source: Renegade Immortal ch. 243, 268 · Wang Lin's Ji Realm: each use wounds his Nascent Soul (ch. 243), and it kills (ch. 268)
kultivator.technique.ji_realm.lore: Each use wounds the Nascent Soul; each use kills.
kultivator.technique.profound_mystery_fu: An orb of your main Dao and your strongest second Dao (≥ 30) flies up to 32 blocks and bursts in r 6→12: 2.2× plus both Daos' domain pulses at ×2, and a pair effect: Sword+Lightning chain lightning, Fire+Ice ×1.5 and slowness, Body+Space pull and qi burn, Life+Shadow drain, Ice+Space root, Sword+Space blade wave, Fire+Lightning fire and stun, Body+Life heals allies 20%; any other pair: radius ×1.5.

Source: Coiling Dragon Book 15 ch. 42, Book 21 ch. 10 · Linley fuses profound mysteries: the Throbbing Pulse with Gravitational Space and the Essence of the Earth, later his earth, fire, water and wind mysteries
Two mysteries, turned until they become one.
Only a player can fuse these mysteries.
Needs a second Dao with comprehension ≥ 30.
kultivator.technique.buddha_wrath_tang_l: Throw a lotus up to 24 blocks; it opens and looses 108 blades three times (r 10→16): 0.7× and Poison II 5 s each; its core (r 4→6) deals 2.5×.
Source: Soul Land · 佛怒唐莲 Buddha's Fury Tang Lotus, the mechanism hidden weapon Tang San built, the hardest Tang Sect mechanism to make (not the disciples' BTTH flame lotus Teratai Api Amarah Buddha)
The hardest mechanism of the Tang Sect, and the most beautiful.
2 charges (8 s each): flash 24→40 blocks in 2 ticks, untouchable; monsters along the path take 3× and are stunned 1 s; then lightning jumps from the last one to 3→6 more for 1.5×.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 风雷翅 Wind-Thunder Wings, the Thunder Roc wings Han Li tricked Feng Xi out of (not the Lightning art Lei Zhenzi's Wings)
Wings won from Feng Xi, rumbling with wind and thunder.
kultivator.technique.proud_golden_body.d: Gilded skin for 25 s: damage taken −20%, rising to −60% as your health falls; technique damage +0%, rising to +100% as your health falls (within the ×3 cap); melee attackers are burned by golden blood: 0.4× fire per second for 3 s.
kultivator.technique.proud_golden_body.s: Source: Martial Peak · 傲骨金身 Proud Golden Body, the body art Yang Kai gains from the black book (the low-health scaling is inspired by it)
kultivator.technique.proud_golden_body.l: The lower he falls, the harder he stands.
kultivator.technique.fa_tian_xiang_di.de: Grow ×3 (rising to ×4 at True Immortal; ×2 when there is no room) for 30→45 s at 5 qi/s: Strength III, reach +6, melee hits sweep r 6 / 140° for 2×; recast inside the form to stomp (r 6→12): 3× and launch.
kultivator.technique.fa_tian_xiang_di.so: Source: Journey to the West ch. 3, 6 · 法天象地 Modeling Heaven on Earth, Wukong's sky-reaching giant body. The Body Dao's Cosmic Giant Form (True Immortal) is the avatar-only version; this one grows the caster
kultivator.technique.fa_tian_xiang_di.lo: His head touches the sky, his feet press the earth.
kultivator.technique.burning_heart.desc: Forbidden: costs 35% of your current health (never lethal) and 20% qi. For 15 s: technique damage +100% (within the ×3 cap), qi costs ×0.5, cooldowns ×1.4 faster, and your carving shapes +1 radius. Afterwards: Weakness II, no qi regeneration and technique damage ×0.7 for 60 s.
kultivator.technique.burning_heart.sourc: Source: Against the Gods · Burning Heart, the Heretic God Art's 2nd realm, which turns the profound energy light red (the multiplier is game design)
kultivator.technique.burning_heart.lore: The profound energy burns light red, and so does the price.
kultivator.technique.life_death_hex.desc: A hex field of r 10→20 at the aim (≤ 32) for 10 s: monsters take 0.4× soul damage per second and Slowness II; each hexed kill heals you 3% and chains 1× to 2 more within 4. When it ends, every monster inside below 25% health is executed (bosses take 4× instead).
kultivator.technique.life_death_hex.sour: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 882 · the Sixth Demon Sealing Hex, Life-Death Hexing (the vortex and the end execution are game design)
kultivator.technique.life_death_hex.lore: Life and death turn in the same vortex.
kultivator.technique.ruyi_staff.desc: Charge 1 s while the staff grows, then it topples along your aim from 3 blocks ahead (40→64 long, 3 wide, 12 high): 9× and launch. From tier 7 two more staffs fall at ±20° for 4.5×. Releasing early hits at the charged share (at least 50%).
kultivator.technique.ruyi_staff.source: Source: Journey to the West ch. 3 · 如意金箍棒 Ruyi Jingu Bang of 13,500 catties from the Dragon King's treasury, which grows or shrinks at will (the extra staffs are game design)
kultivator.technique.ruyi_staff.lore: Thirteen thousand five hundred catties, as large or small as its master wills.
kultivator.technique.three_life_saving_h: For 20 minutes, 1 hair (2 from Immortal Ascension Tahap 6, 3 at True Immortal) saves you from a lethal hit: health 30%, ailments cleansed, damage −80% for 2 s, a safe step back of 8 blocks and a push on monsters within 6. Never against tribulations, the void or /kill; shares the 10-minute technique rescue lockout. A held Totem acts first.
Source: Journey to the West ch. 15, 75 · 三根救命的毫毛: Guanyin gives Wukong three life-saving hairs (ch. 15); he uses them inside the yin-yang vase (ch. 75)
Three golden hairs from Guanyin, for when there is no other way out.
A dragon-soul domain of r 12→24 follows you for 10→15 s: monsters lose track of you, take 0.4× soul damage per second, Slowness III and are pushed away; every 3 s they are stunned for 1 s (bosses rooted briefly).
Source: Against the Gods ch. 316, 1064, 1099 · Dragon Soul Domain, a Dragon God mental domain that briefly stuns foes or makes them lose track
A Dragon God's will presses down, and foes forget whom they hunted.
kultivator.technique.myriad_cauldron.des: A cauldron drops from 24 blocks up onto the aim (≤ 40) after 1 s, r 8→16: 5× and a pull to its centre; then it settles for 4 s: monsters are rooted (bosses 1 s) and burn in mother qi for 0.5× per second. Each kill restores 3% qi (at most 15% per cast).
kultivator.technique.myriad_cauldron.sou: Source: Shrouded the Heavens · 万物母气鼎 Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron, Ye Fan's cauldron forged around the mother-qi root, with the green copper at its core
kultivator.technique.myriad_cauldron.lor: Forged around the mother-qi root, with green copper at its heart.
kultivator.technique.xing_secret.desc: For 10→15 s: Speed IV, attack speed +100%, cooldowns ×2 faster (within the floor, never ultimates); monsters within 6→10 get Slowness IV and are stunned for 0.5 s every 3 s.
kultivator.technique.xing_secret.source: Source: Shrouded the Heavens · 行字秘 the Xing Secret, the speed secret of the Nine Secrets (the effects are inspired by it)
kultivator.technique.xing_secret.lore: Of the Nine Secrets, the swiftest.
kultivator.technique.karmic_hex.desc: Your locked target (≤ 32) takes 4× armour-piercing damage, and karma threads bind it to 12→24 monsters within 24 for 12 s: damage dealt to one is also dealt to the others at 50% (bosses 25%). If it dies to the hex, the threads jump to the linked monster with the most health.
kultivator.technique.karmic_hex.source: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 751, 858 · the Seventh Demon Sealing Hex, Karmic Hexing, which sees and hexes karma threads
kultivator.technique.karmic_hex.lore: See the threads of karma, and pull.
kultivator.technique.six_dao_reincarnati: A six-spoked wheel replays the last 6 distinct arts you cast in the past 2 minutes (no ultimates, specials or itself) at your aim, one every 0.3 s, at ×0.6 (+0.05 per tier above Immortal Ascension Tahap 7, at most ×0.8), free; then a nova of r 10→20 deals 4×. One boss cap; the replays give no mastery and carve nothing.
Source: Perfect World ch. 1091, 1120 · Six Dao Reincarnations Heavenly Art: introduced in ch. 1091, it merges Shi Hao's six precious techniques into one display in ch. 1120
Six precious techniques, turned into a single display.
kultivator.technique.heavenly_fate_finge: Charge 1 s, then a colossal finger of light falls on your locked target (≤ 64; line of sight, or none while your Divine Sense is active): 12× armour-piercing damage and root 3 s (bosses 0.75 s); everything within r 6 of it takes 3×.
Source: Renegade Immortal ch. 1254 · Heavenly Fate Finger, the All-Seer's spell, which Wang Lin uses after briefly fusing with the All-Seer's soul
The All-Seer points, and fate obeys.
